Terms of Service

Last Updated: August 2026

1. Services Offered

AIPrintStudio provides pre-press graphic reproduction, vector tracing, CMYK color management, and file preparation services for AI-generated images. We prepare digital master files (.AI, .EPS, .PDF/X, .SVG, .PNG, .TIFF) for commercial physical manufacturing.

2. 100% Print Shop Acceptance Guarantee

We guarantee that all files delivered by AIPrintStudio comply with commercial printing press standards. If your print shop flags a preflight error (e.g. bleeds, color mode, vector curves), we will revise the file free of charge or communicate directly with your printer until approved.

3. Commercial Rights & Ownership

Upon final delivery, the client retains 100% full commercial rights to use, print, trademark, and distribute the completed vector and raster master files.

4. Turnaround Times

Standard turnaround is 12 to 24 hours from project confirmation. Complex multi-page packaging and large banner scopes may take up to 48 hours as agreed during initial consultation.
